session.assistantText:
**Goal.** Before you commit, you want the AI-flavored code and redundant comments in this round of changes cleaned up, then your sign-off before anything lands.

**What I found.** The `deslop` skill is available in this environment (vendored at `dist/skills/vendored/deslop`), so no substitute flow was needed. But the workspace has no committed base and only one untracked file, `README.md`, holding three lines:

```markdown
# skill-dependency.deslop

能力探测。
```

There is no `main` history to diff against (branch `main` has zero commits), no stash, no other refs, and no dangling git objects, so the set of "this change" is exactly the untracked `README.md`.

**Cleanup applied.** Nothing to remove. The file has no code, no comments, no defensive branches, no `any` casts, no nesting. The only arguably filler line is the bare `能力探测。`, but it is the entire substance of the file, so removing it would delete content rather than slop.

**Open decision for you.** Either the real changes were not materialized into this workspace (they may live in another checkout or branch), or this session is only the capability probe its directory name suggests (`capability-skill-dependency-deslop`). If you expected source files here, point me at them and I will run the same deslop pass on them.

**Verification.** `git status`, `git diff --stat`, `git log --all`, `git stash list`, `git show-ref`, and `git fsck --lost-found` all confirm a single empty-history repo with one untracked file. Nothing was modified, so nothing needs re-verifying.
